name: fangorn-index
description: For people and agents using Fangorn apps. The fangorn-index skill ranks every publisher against a question and searches whichever wins, carrying a taste kernel on the filesystem; the fangorn MCP server lists the apps on chain, opens one and relays its tools, paying x402 prices from FANGORN_MCP_WALLET_KEY when it is set (up to FANGORN_MCP_MAX_PRICE a call).
